subject: Bridging credit request for EdgeSight pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Bridging credit request for EdgeSight pilot

Grace / Kim — quick one. EdgeSight's pilot usage blew past the initial allocation overnight (sustained chat + embedding volume). They’re at ~85% of the pilot cap and expecting another spike after the integration test tomorrow.

Customer ask: one-time top-up to keep the pilot running through the end of their evaluation window (14 days). Ben proposal: 75,000 token credit (approx $3k list-equivalent) conditional on:
- 14-day extension of the pilot window
- conversion to a paid Dedicated plan (or equivalent subscription) within 60 days of extension end
- clear success metrics: 10k monthly active API calls or 50M tokens/month projected on go-live

I attached a short term-sheet with the exact language (bridging_credit_terms_edgesight_v1.pdf). This is an end-of-quarter push — they’re in final procurement review and that credit materially helps unblock exec sign-off.

Request: Can I get approval to gift the 75k token uplift? If you prefer a smaller amount we can offer 50k and close faster. Need a decision today so we can send the revised DocuSign and keep momentum.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: bridging_credit_terms_edgesight_v1.pdf (pdf, 45KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridging credit request for EdgeSight pilot

Ben — thanks for the context and the term-sheet. I’m supportive of a short bridge but would like to tighten the asks. My thoughts:
- Approve a one-time 60k token credit instead of 75k (keeps spend impact lower, still meaningful for the customer)
- Add a 30-day progress checkpoint with the CSM to review logs/quality; credit forfeited if misuse or no engagement
- Require a signed purchase order or DocuSign SOW that references the conversion commitment you outlined

Kimberly — can you confirm this fits within the discretionary closing funds for AE credits this quarter? If finance needs a different routing, tell us now. Marissa — please prepare a one-slide mutual action plan for the customer that we can attach to the DocuSign.

Ben — if EdgeSight accepts 60k + MAP + PO, proceed. Please include the HubSpot deal id and attach the PO when you send DocuSign.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com
